title: CompMD configuration
description: The packs a host gives its documents, with their trust, and which packs a document may import: compmd.config.json, or the compmd key of package.json.

packs.description: The packs that get more than a strict sandbox, or are ambient, by pack name (@scope/pack) or folder path (./components). Every other installed pack is available, strict.

imports.description: any (the default): a document may import any installed pack; listed: only the packs listed here.

deny.description: Packs denied, as the host's own policy: all versions, or those in version, with the reason readers see.

maxPackSize.description: A pack whose files are larger is left out: bytes, or a size such as "5 MB".

libraries.description: npm packages, installed in the app, that the frames offer components through their import map, besides React and Svelte.

oneOf.description: An npm package name, such as d3.

trust.description: strict (the default), permissive (network to its origins, and host if given), or trusted (a folder in the app only).

network.description: The origins a permissive pack may reach, each https://host[:port].

host.description: Whether a permissive pack's components get host.

ambient.description: Whether every document gets the pack's names without importing it.

version.description: A semver range the installed version must satisfy.
